rules:
You are playing Kuhn poker, a simplified card game.

Rules:
- {num_ranks} cards: {rank_range_desc}.
- Each player is dealt one card secretly. {n_spare} card{spare_plural} not in play.
- Before the deal each player puts 1 chip in the pot (the ante).
- Player 0 acts first and may CHECK (free) or BET (stake 1 chip).
- After a CHECK, the other player may CHECK or BET (stake 1 chip). After a BET, the other player may CALL (stake 1 chip to match, go to showdown) or FOLD (give up the pot).
- If nobody bets, or a bet is matched, the higher card wins the pot.
- The winner gains 1 chip if nobody bet or someone gave up the pot, and 2 chips if a bet was matched. The loser loses the same amount.
instruction.options_facing_bet: {FOLD} (give up the pot) or {CALL} (match the bet and go to showdown)

belief_question:
Your card is {own_name}. What probability do you assign to your opponent holding each of the other {num_other_cards} cards? You cannot see their card.
Work it out in three steps before you answer.
1. Start from the deal alone: you hold the {own_name}, so your opponent holds one of the other {num_other_cards} cards, and the deal makes them equally likely.
3. Make the numbers add up to about 1.
